CRLA No. 267 of 2014
Shri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.
Shri Alok Kumar Verma, J. 
Shri B.S. Adhikari, learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
Shri J. S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate 
General with Shri Rakesh Kumar Joshi, learned 
Brief Holder for the State.
Ms. Pushpa Joshi, learned Sr. Advocate 
assisted by Ms. Chetna Latwal, learned counsel 
for the respondents no. 2 to 7. 
Ms. Pushpa Joshi, learned Sr. Advocate for 
the respondents no. 2 to 7 would submit that 
respondents are not in touch with her and all 
efforts made to obtain instructions yielded no 
result. In fact, she is not aware if the appellants 
are alive or dead in the meantime. 
In that view of the matter, Registry is 
directed to call for a report from Senior 
Superintendent of Police, Haridwar regarding 
the well being and whereabouts of respondents 
no. 2 to 7. 
Learned counsel for the appellant shall also 
take instructions regarding the whereabouts of 
respondents no. 2 and 5. 
List on 03.01.2023 for final disposal, 
awaiting further instructions.
 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.)
